workflow.message: Authorized design documents classified and bounded by signed artifact access.
Revision, page, effective status, and supersession metadata inspected.
Verified scale and reviewed element candidates matched the orchestration request.
Quantity formula registry replayed source-backed dimensions without LLM arithmetic.
Approved norms, prices, productivity, VAT, and contingency were replayed exactly.
WBS, dependencies, resources, calendar, and CPM were calculated deterministically.
Every non-calculation source is authorized; all numeric authority remains deterministic.
Draft artifacts are queued for role-correct human review and are never auto-approved.

reviewQueue.reason: Estimator must review formula mappings, dimensions, and adjustments.
Project manager must review prices, assumptions, tax, and contingency.
Project manager must review WBS, dependencies, resources, and CPM dates.
Approved baseline can only be created by an explicit project-manager decision.

workflow.message: Approved operational snapshot inputs were loaded through authorized read-only tools.
Eligibility, priority, feasibility, target, and conflicts were replayed without LLM arithmetic.
Approved actuals, signed photo metadata, and deterministic verification were joined.
Rolling productivity, projected finish, drivers, and recovery impacts remain deterministic.
Tool and approved-state sources were validated; no AI-generated numeric fact is accepted.
Plan, verification, and recovery remain drafts pending authorized human review.
